payload.tension: The passage states isaiah 29:2–12 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is poured out; the wording centers on “Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
